headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs 8-4 behind a strong performance from Michael McGreevy, while the San Francisco Giants cruised past the Colorado Rockies 7-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Athletics placed left fielder Tyler Soderstrom on the 10-day injured list due to left hip impingement, effective retroactive to August 15, 2026. The Boston Red Sox have also placed DH Masataka Yoshida on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain and RHP Justin Slaten on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 13, 2026, with right elbow inflammation.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash. The Athletics also traded Ornelas to the Brewers, while the Boston Red Sox traded CF Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a player-to-be-named-later deal.

top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by a dominant performance from Michael McGreevy. McGreevy pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters while allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Logan Webb. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a 3-hit, 3-RBI game.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Tyler Soderstrom on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics left fielder Tyler Soderstrom has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left hip impingement. The move is retroactive to August 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their roster with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
